name: pe-originals-fullstack
description: PE_ORIGINALS - full-stack e-commerce (Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma + optional Redis)

scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npm run seed
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend
